a constitutional right: Freedom of speech is a constitutional right, so the government cannot stop people from expressing their opinions.
言論自由是憲法權利，所以政府不能阻止人民表達意見。
a constitutional monarchy: Japan is a constitutional monarchy, which means it has an emperor, but the elected government actually runs the country.
日本是君主立憲制國家，也就是說它有天皇，但實際上是由民選政府治理國家。
constructive criticism: My teacher gave me constructive criticism, pointing out my mistakes and showing me how to make my essay better.
老師給了我建設性的批評，指出我的錯誤並告訴我如何把作文寫得更好。
a constructive dialogue: The two sides finally sat down and had a constructive dialogue that helped them find a solution together.
雙方終於坐下來進行了有建設性的對話，幫助他們一起找到解決辦法。
play a constructive role: Parents can play a constructive role in helping teenagers solve problems instead of just blaming them.
父母可以在幫助青少年解決問題上發揮建設性作用，而不只是責怪他們。
a contagious disease: Because measles is a contagious disease, the sick boy had to stay home so that his classmates would not catch it.
因為麻疹是傳染病，生病的男孩必須待在家，以免同學被傳染。
contagious laughter: Her contagious laughter soon spread through the classroom, and before long everyone was laughing along with her.
她有感染力的笑聲很快傳遍教室，不久大家都跟著她一起笑了。
Enthusiasm is contagious: Enthusiasm is contagious, so when our coach got excited about the game, the whole team soon felt excited too.
熱情會感染他人，所以當教練對比賽感到興奮時，全隊很快也跟著興奮起來。
contemporary art: The new museum shows contemporary art created by young artists who are living and working today.
這座新博物館展出當代藝術，作品出自如今仍在世並創作的年輕藝術家。
contemporary society: In contemporary society, most people depend on smartphones for news, shopping, and keeping in touch with friends.
在當代社會，大多數人依賴智慧型手機獲取新聞、購物以及和朋友保持聯絡。
contemporary with Shakespeare: The writer Ben Jonson was contemporary with Shakespeare; the two men lived in London and wrote plays at the same time.
作家班·瓊森與莎士比亞同時代；兩人同時住在倫敦並創作劇本。
be content with one's life: Although he is not rich, my uncle is content with his life and never complains about having a small house.
雖然不富有，我叔叔對生活感到滿足，從不抱怨房子小。
be content to wait: Even though the line was long, she was content to wait, happily reading her novel without a single complaint.
雖然隊伍很長，她甘願等待，愉快地讀著小說，一句怨言都沒有。
a continental breakfast: The hotel offers a continental breakfast of bread, butter, jam, coffee, and juice, but it serves no hot dishes.
這家飯店提供歐陸式早餐，有麵包、奶油、果醬、咖啡和果汁，但沒有熱食。
the continental shelf: Many kinds of fish live in the shallow water of the continental shelf, where the sea floor slopes gently from the coast.
許多種魚類生活在大陸棚的淺水區，那裡的海床從海岸緩緩傾斜。
continental Europe: After finishing school in London, she took a train to continental Europe and traveled through France, Germany, and Italy.
在倫敦完成學業後，她搭火車前往歐洲大陸，遊歷了法國、德國和義大利。
continual interruptions: The continual interruptions from my little brother, who kept coming in every few minutes, made it hard to study.
我弟弟每隔幾分鐘就跑進來，不斷的打擾讓我很難讀書。
continual complaints: The manager grew tired of the continual complaints about the noise, which came from neighbors again and again every week.
經理對鄰居每週一再提出的噪音問題，接二連三的抱怨感到厭煩。
continuous rain: After a week of continuous rain without a single break, the streets were flooded and schools had to close.
連續一週不間斷的雨毫無停歇，街道淹水，學校只好停課。
a continuous line: Without lifting your pencil from the paper, draw a continuous line from one side of the page to the other.
不要讓鉛筆離開紙面，從紙的一邊畫一條連續不斷的線到另一邊。
continuous assessment: Our school uses continuous assessment, so our grades come from weekly quizzes and projects instead of one final exam.
我們學校採用持續性評量，所以成績來自每週的小考和專題，而不是一次期末考。
the present continuous tense: We use the present continuous tense, as in "She is reading now," to talk about actions happening at this moment.
我們使用現在進行式，例如「她現在正在閱讀」，來談論此刻正在發生的動作。
on the contrary: I didn't find the movie boring at all; on the contrary, it was the most exciting film I have seen this year.
我一點也不覺得那部電影無聊；相反地，那是我今年看過最刺激的電影。
contrary to popular belief: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind; in fact, many of them can see quite well at night.
與普遍看法相反，蝙蝠並不是瞎的；事實上，許多蝙蝠在夜間視力相當好。
contrary to expectations: Contrary to expectations, the weakest team in the league won the championship, surprising fans and reporters alike.
出乎意料，聯盟中最弱的隊伍贏得了冠軍，讓球迷和記者都大吃一驚。
a contrary view: Most students supported the new rule, but Amy expressed a contrary view and explained why she strongly disagreed.
大多數學生支持新規定，但艾咪表達了相反的觀點，並解釋她為何強烈反對。
quite the contrary: People think he is lazy, but quite the contrary, he works two jobs and studies at night as well.
大家以為他很懶，但恰恰相反，他身兼兩份工作，晚上還念書。
a controversial decision: The referee's controversial decision in the last minute led to angry arguments among fans of both teams.
裁判在最後一分鐘有爭議的決定，引發兩隊球迷之間激烈的爭吵。
a highly controversial figure: The politician is a highly controversial figure; some people love him, while others strongly dislike everything he does.
這位政治人物是個備受爭議的人物；有些人很愛他，有些人則強烈厭惡他做的一切。
a controversial issue: Whether students should be allowed to use phones in class is a controversial issue that parents and teachers often argue about.
學生是否應該被允許在課堂上使用手機是個爭議性議題，家長和老師常為此爭論。
